verdict.rationale: The IRS runs machine channels (MeF XML transmission for authorized e-file providers, and IRIS Application to Application), so event subscriptions are a fair question for this service. However, nothing in the evidence documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks or any event subscription mechanism. Probes also found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt, so the axis applies but the capability is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
